Results.ReviewText: We Love this grill, and it was easy to put togethertoo.  The the base plate was damaged on arrival which really sucked, but through simply texting with customer support we received a new one within days.  The food that comes off the grill is amazing everytime, and the heat stays pretty contained.  We have a smaller patio and can sit close in the summer heat and not be overwhelmed when we're hitting 400° or higher.  Well worth every penny, you think for a minute is Weber is a bit too pricey?  But what you get far exceeds the extra $100-200 a lesser grill costs.
Results.Title: Should have purchased years ago

Results.ReviewText: Love the way it heats up, and seems to cook evenly! The only issue I might have, is the apparatus that holds the propane tank! While it’s a great idea to keep one informed of the amount of propane, it can be rather difficult to hang the tank! There is limited access to install your tank!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is WELL MADE,  sturdy.  Good temperature control with the 2 burners.   The side shelves easily fold up and down and are indispensable when grilling.  The hooks on the end of the shelves are very useful.  At first, I was taken aback with how the propane tank mounts, but it is a brilliant design, showing how much propane is left in the tank.    I highly recommend this grill.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear about the experience you've had with your Spirit E-210. New grills will run hotter until the grill has been used and has some grease built up inside the lid, cookbox, and other surfaces that will reduce the reflection inside the grill and bring the heat down somewhat.

Our Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Thank you for your feedback. Sorry to hear about your experience. We suggest using heat-resistant barbecue mitts or gloves when operating the grill, as stated in the owner's guide. When in doubt, please wear them. The good ones are insulated and protect both hands and forearms. 

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
